parameters.description_en:
The ID of the edge instance. You can obtain it by moving the mouse pointer over the target edge instance name on the **Edge Instances** page in the [Edge Computing console](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list).  

You can also call the [QueryEdgeInstance](~~135214~~) API to obtain the instance ID.
parameters.description_zh:
边缘实例的ID。在[边缘计算控制台](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list)的**边缘实例**页面中，鼠标悬浮在目标边缘实例名称上获取ID。

您也可以调用[QueryEdgeInstance](~~135214~~)接口获取。

element_fields.name: format

element_fields.description_en:
The configuration content.

- When the value of the **Configs.N.Format** parameter is KV or JSON, specify the configuration content here. For the format of the configuration content, see [Driver Channel Configuration Description](~~172321~~).

- When the value of the **Configs.N.Format** parameter is FILE, specify an Alibaba Cloud Object Storage Service (OSS) URL here. Obtain the OSS URL by invoking the [CreateOssPreSignedAddress](~~155858~~) API.
element_fields.description_zh:
配置内容。

- **Configs.N.Format**参数的值为KV或JSON时，此处请填写配置内容。配置内容格式，请参见[驱动通道配置说明](~~172321~~)。

- **Configs.N.Format**参数的值为FILE时，此处请填写阿里云对象存储OSS地址。OSS地址请调用[CreateOssPreSignedAddress](~~155858~~)接口获取。
